sources.notes: New original concept pixels inspected: curved outer lens walls, hood overhang and axial spine rhythm visible; eye heights differ between views and remain too short versus primary Fig1. Primary Fig1 A/B/D takes structural priority: increase exposed eye elevation while preserving narrow fore-aft curved shape; C establishes crescent/kidney planform, D/E meaningful external overhang. Author hidden inner wall as quiet closed shell, no soft anatomy. Old thorax remains stylistic; modest axial spines justified only by primary lateral photo; exact number deliberately unclaimed.
